emisorForm.invoiceCashSalesHint: Off by default. Most businesses don't declare cash, so cash sales aren't invoiced via the receipt QR or the global invoice. Turn it on only if you want cash sales to be invoiceable. For a sale paid only in cash, without going through the terminal, to go into the global invoice, also turn on "Include in the global invoice the sales charged outside the terminal".
emisorForm.includeCashInAccountingHint: Off by default. Your CASH sales don't enter the fiscal books (IVA, ISR, journal entries). Your “how much did I make?” view always shows them. Turn on only if you want to declare cash.
emisorForm.isnRateHint: State payroll tax (ISN), paid by the employer on wages. Varies by state (~1%–4%). Leave 0 if not applicable; the system computes it on each payroll.
emisorForm.bimestralOnly621: The SAT only allows the bimonthly periodicity for tax regime 621 (Incorporación Fiscal).
emisorForm.includeOffTerminalSalesInGlobal: Include in the global invoice the sales charged outside the terminal (cash, transfer, vouchers and custom payment types)
emisorForm.includeOffTerminalSalesInGlobalHint: Off by default: those sales do not go into the global invoice. Cash also needs "Invoice cash sales". If your business has several RFCs it does not apply, because it is not known which one they belong to.

merchants.globalHelp: Billing on: lets this merchant issue CFDIs. Self-invoice: customers invoice themselves via the receipt QR. Include in global: Avoqado automatically issues the global invoice (on the issuer's schedule) to the General Public for sales nobody invoiced. Turn this on ONLY if your accountant does NOT issue it separately. In accounting: turn off to exclude this merchant from your fiscal books (journal entries / IVA / ISR); your management view still shows it.

confirmGlobal.title: Let Avoqado issue your global invoice?
confirmGlobal.description: With this on, Avoqado will automatically issue a global invoice, on the issuer's schedule, to the General Public for this merchant's sales that no customer invoiced. If your accountant already issues that global invoice, do NOT enable this — you'd be reporting the same income twice to the SAT. Enable only if you want Avoqado to handle the global.

reason.NOT_A_REFUND: This payment is not a refund, so it has no credit note.
reason.REFUND_NOT_COMPLETED: The refund is not complete yet; the credit note can be issued when it finishes.
reason.NO_ORIGINAL_CFDI: This sale has no stamped invoice, so there is nothing to credit with a credit note.
reason.ORIGINAL_CANCELLED: The original invoice is cancelled; a credit note does not apply to a cancelled invoice.
reason.ORIGINAL_CANCEL_PENDING: The original invoice has a cancellation requested; the credit note can be issued once it is resolved.
reason.ORIGINAL_EN_SUSTITUCION: The original invoice is being replaced; the credit note can be issued once that finishes.
reason.TIP_ONLY: This refund is only a tip, which was never part of the invoice: it has no credit note.
reason.EXCEEDS_REMAINING: There is nothing left to credit on the original invoice.
reason.ORIGINAL_IVA_MIXTO: The original invoice has several VAT rates; issue this credit note with your accountant.
reason.ORIGINAL_ENTRADA_INVALIDA: We could not read how the original invoice was built; contact support to review it.
reason.ESPERA_XML: We are retrieving the invoice XML; try again in a few minutes.
reason.XML_IRRECUPERABLE: The XML of the original invoice cannot be retrieved, so the credit note is not issued here. Contact support.
reason.ARTICULO_SIN_EVIDENCIA: We cannot verify how much was invoiced for a refunded item. You can credit the refund by amount.
reason.ARTICULOS_NO_CUADRAN: The refunded items do not add up to what was refunded; review the refund.
reason.ARTICULO_EXCEDE_LO_FACTURADO: The amount refunded for an item is more than what was invoiced for it.
reason.CENTAVOS_DE_REDONDEO: The refund collides with a few cents of rounding on the invoice; issue this credit note with your accountant.
reason.SIN_MONTO_POR_ARTICULO: This invoice did not record how much was invoiced for each item. You can credit the refund by amount.
reason.REPARTO_DE_ENTREGA_INVALIDO: The per-rate split of this delivery adjustment cannot be read; contact support.
reason.IMPORTE_DEVUELTO_INVALIDO: The refund amount is not valid for a credit note.
reason.OCHO_SIN_REGLA: This credit note would carry the 8% border VAT, which is not credited here yet; issue it with your accountant.
reason.NO_CUADRA_CON_EL_PAC: The credit note does not match the PAC rules to the cent; contact support.
reason.MODALIDAD_NO_PERMITIDA: This refund does have the per-item detail, so it is not credited by amount.
reason.SIN_FORMA_DE_PAGO: There is no valid payment form for the credit note; issue it with your accountant.

creditNote.waitingXmlStopped: The invoice XML has not arrived yet. Check again in a few minutes.

manifiesto.efirmaNotice: The letter is signed with the e.firma (.cer and .key files plus their password) of the invoicing RFC. It is not the CSD: it is the electronic signature of the person or company. Your certificates are not stored; they are only used to sign.

replaceDialog.title: Correct this invoice amount
replaceDialog.description: A NEW invoice is stamped with the correct amount from the bill, related to this one, and the SAT is asked to cancel the current one. The server computes the amount from the bill — it cannot be typed in.
replaceDialog.step1: 1. The corrected invoice is stamped (related to the current one).
replaceDialog.step2: 2. Cancellation of the current one is requested with motive 01, pointing at the new one.
replaceDialog.step3: 3. Cancellation can take time: the SAT sometimes needs the customer to accept it.
replaceDialog.cancelPending: The previous invoice is STILL valid: its cancellation is pending at the SAT. Check back later; the new one is already valid.
replaceDialog.cancelRejected: The SAT did not accept cancelling the previous invoice, so it IS STILL VALID. The new one is stamped. If you still need it, request it again with “Finish the replacement” on the previous invoice's row.
replaceDialog.rejectedIntro: No invoice was stamped. Here is why:
replaceDialog.cancelNotSent: The previous invoice IS STILL VALID: its cancellation was not sent. To request it again, use “Finish the replacement” on the previous invoice's row (no other invoice is stamped).
replaceDialog.cancelNotRequested: The previous invoice IS STILL VALID: its cancellation could not be requested. Once you resolve it, use “Finish the replacement” on the previous invoice's row (no other invoice is stamped).
replaceDialog.finishDescription: The corrected invoice {{folio}} is already stamped. What is left is asking the SAT to cancel this one (motive 01, pointing at the corrected one). No other invoice is stamped.
replaceDialog.finishRejectedTitle: The SAT did not accept the cancellation
replaceDialog.finishUnconfirmedTitle: The cancellation could not be confirmed
replaceDialog.cancelInDoubt: The previous invoice IS STILL VALID for now: the SAT gave no clear answer and we are confirming its cancellation (it can take up to 24 hours). Do not request it again; if you want to know now, use “Check status” on the previous invoice's row.
replaceDialog.cancelUnconfirmed: The previous invoice IS STILL VALID: we could not confirm whether its cancellation was sent. Check the previous invoice's row; if it offers “Finish the replacement”, request it from there (no other invoice is stamped).
replaceDialog.stampInDoubt: The corrected invoice is in doubt: the PAC gave no clear answer and may have stamped it. Do not issue it again; check its status in the invoice list in a few minutes (it confirms itself).
replaceDialog.stampRejected: The PAC did not stamp the corrected invoice; the previous one is still valid. Check the sale's tax details before trying again.
replaceDialog.genericError: The invoice could not be replaced. Try again in a few minutes.
